**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole nuts have a bulk density of about 0.55 g/ml, giving 79 × 0.55 ≈ 43 g. As a cross-check, about 34 almonds at about 1.2 g each is about 41 g. I'll use about 42 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Almonds have about 579 kcal per 100 g. 42 g × 5.79 ≈ 243 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 34 almonds is a bit more than one standard 28 g serving (about 23 almonds). So 42 g and about 240 kcal is plausible.
